structured_output.rationale: 835 shows claim-level denial: CO-16 with MOA N286 on all three lines. N286 = missing/invalid referring provider NPI. The 837P has no referring/ordering provider loop (Loop 2310A absent). Medicare Part B requires ordering/referring NPI for therapy services. Correct and resubmit as new original (CLM05-3=1) with valid referring provider NPI.

root_cause.explanation: Claim denied CO-16 + N286 at claim level. No ordering/referring provider NPI in the 837P. Medicare Part B requires it for therapy CPTs 97110/97140/97112.

next_action.detail: Add the ordering/referring provider name and NPI (verify in PECOS) to the 837P. Resubmit as a new original claim (CLM05-3=1). Do not use frequency 7 on Part B.

evidence.fact: CLP status 4 (denied), MOA***N286 at claim level; all three SVC lines carry CAS*CO*16.
No referring/ordering provider loop (NM1*DN or NM1*DK) present in the claim.
EB*1 active coverage for DOS 2026-07-20; eligibility is not the issue.
CO-16 + N286 = missing referring provider NPI; correct and resubmit as new original on Part B.

citations.rule: CO-16 + N286: correct referring NPI and resubmit as new original (CLM05-3=1) on Medicare Part B
